bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; requiring specific content in a report from Minnesota Management and Budget on agency actions with respect to legislative auditor findings; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 16A.057, subdivision 5.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 16A.057, subdivision 5, is amended to read:

Subd. 5.
Monitoring Office of the Legislative Auditor audits.
The commissioner must review audit reports from the Office of the Legislative Auditor and take appropriate steps to address internal control problems found in executive agencies. The commissioner must report annually by January 15 to the chairs and ranking minority members of the committees in the senate with jurisdiction over finance and the house of representatives with jurisdiction over ways and means with a detailed list of recommended actions made by the legislative auditor. For each of those recommended actions:

(1) describe in detail the actions taken in accordance with the recommendation;

(2) assess the degree to which the recommended action is complete;

(3) explain why the recommended action has not been completed;

(4) describe the work required to complete the agency's response to the recommended action; and

(5) provide the timeline for completion of the agency's response to fully address the concern raised by the legislative auditor.
additions: The commissioner must report annually by January 15 to the chairs and ranking minority members of the committees in the senate with jurisdiction over finance and the house of representatives with jurisdiction over ways and means with a detailed list of recommended actions made by the legislative auditor. For each of those recommended actions:
(1) describe in detail the actions taken in accordance with the recommendation;
(2) assess the degree to which the recommended action is complete;
(3) explain why the recommended action has not been completed;
(4) describe the work required to complete the agency's response to the recommended action; and
(5) provide the timeline for completion of the agency's response to fully address the concern raised by the legislative auditor.
